name: Rustblade Arsenal
story: A smith sharpens a sword for someone who has not come.

beforeStory.speaker: The Long Road
beforeStory.text: A smith works in the arsenal. A finished sword rests beside him. He lifts it, finds another fault, and begins again.

beforeStory.speaker: Smith
beforeStory.text: Not yet. The edge has to be right when they arrive.

afterStory.speaker: The Long Road
afterStory.text: The smith lifts the sword to the light again.

afterStory.speaker: Smith
afterStory.text: Not yet. I would know if the edge were wrong.

name: White Stone Gate
story: The white gate admits only those who can name their destination.

beforeStory.speaker: Mara Venn
beforeStory.text: I will recognise it when I see it.

beforeStory.speaker: Gatekeeper
beforeStory.text: That is not a destination. Return when you have one.

afterStory.speaker: Mara Venn
afterStory.text: For a moment I almost gave him a name. Any name. It would have been easier.

name: Silent Hospice
story: The hospice keeps its sleepers undisturbed, even when they want to wake.

beforeStory.speaker: The Long Road
beforeStory.text: The hospice is quiet. A patient reaches for a window latch; the physician gently closes the window first.

beforeStory.speaker: Physician
beforeStory.text: There is no need to leave while you are tired.

beforeStory.speaker: Mara Venn
beforeStory.text: I was tired on that bench. I still needed someone to wake me.

afterStory.speaker: Mara Venn
afterStory.text: What if I arrive and still remember nothing?

afterStory.speaker: The Long Road
afterStory.text: Arith sits beside her. After a while, Mara passes him the waterskin.

name: The Nameless General
story: The General offers shelter, but will not open the road beyond it.

beforeStory.speaker: Nameless General
beforeStory.text: Behind the line. You will be safe there.

beforeStory.speaker: Nameless General
beforeStory.text: No one needs to go farther. I have space for both of you.

afterStory.speaker: The Long Road
afterStory.text: The General lowers his hand. No order follows. Arith and Mara step beyond the defence line.

afterStory.speaker: The Long Road
afterStory.text: Arith does not promise to take his place. Far ahead, a bell sounds; another road turns toward a courtyard.
